Bug_Title: HSM: Method hiding should be avoided. (HSM_HIDING_METHOD)
Bug_Details: See SEI CERT rule MET07-J. Never declare a class method that hides a method declared in a superclass or superinterface.
Bug_Explanation: The ChildClass declares a static method 'display' that hides the static method 'display' in its superclass ParentClass. This causes unexpected behavior when calling the method on objects of these classes due to method hiding.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method in the test case triggers the method hiding bug by calling the showBug method which demonstrates the method hiding issue in the ChildClass, leading to unexpected output.
